versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the ElevenLabs Music Generation skill for RunComfy.
- Generate full songs and instrumental tracks (5 seconds to 5 minutes) with structured prompts, section-level control, and multilingual vocals.
- Integrates with the RunComfy CLI to call the ElevenLabs Music model endpoint.
- Supports both vocal and instrumental outputs; commercial-friendly, studio-quality 44.1 kHz stereo audio.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, prompting tips, and example CLI commands.
